label: rem:phi-q-aj-machinery-identification-details
title: $\Phi_q$/AJ identification — full AJ statement, significance, and Lean structure
html:
This note expands \Phi_q / \mathrm{Li}_2^q machinery is the AJ-conjecture machinery: the full AJ-conjecture statement, the significance of the unified context-sorting, and the logical structure of the conditional proposition.

Statement

Let K be a hyperbolic knot complement and J_N(K; q) \in \mathbb{Z}[q^{\pm 1}] its N-colored Jones polynomial. The AJ Conjecture asserts the existence of a non-trivial q-difference operator \hat{A}_K \in \mathcal{A}_q such that:

\hat{A}_K(\hat{L}, \hat{M}; q) \cdot J_N(K; q) \;=\; 0

where \hat{M}f(M) := M\cdot f(M) and \hat{L}f(M) := f(qM), with \hat{L}\hat{M} = q\hat{M}\hat{L}.

The Kashaev-Murakami-Murakami Volume Conjecture for hyperbolic K is governed in the asymptotic by the geometric component of the classical A-polynomial A_K(L, M).

The dilogarithm regulators that appear in the substrate-evaluation chain are exactly:

  • \Phi_q: saddle-point regime of \hat{A}_K \cdot J_N = 0 at q = e^{2\pi i / N} (root-of-unity asymptotic).
  • \mathrm{Li}_2^q: saddle-point regime of \hat{A}_K \cdot J_N = 0 at q \in (0, 1) (real asymptotic, via Stokes).

The two regimes are related by the modular S-transform q \leftrightarrow \tilde{q} = e^{2\pi i / \tau} (modular S-transform q \leftrightarrow \tilde q).

Significance

The framework previously distinguished \Phi_q vs \mathrm{Li}_2^q contexts pragmatically. Per the AJ identification, both are the same algebraic object (\hat{A}_K) viewed through different archimedean lenses. Wiring this explicitly unifies the context-sorting into a single algebraic statement. It provides the categorical-derivation target for the closure question. The AJ identity holds over \mathbb{Z}[q^{\pm 1}]; the framework's Pre-Archimedean / Archimedean split passes through this algebraic gate. The concrete root-of-unity saddle for the figure-eight knot — the \theta = \pi/3 critical point of \mathrm{Im}\,\mathrm{Li}_2(e^{i\theta}), evaluating to \mathrm{Vol}(4_1) — is computed once in the dilog saddle regime.

Logical structure

The proposition is conditional. The backbone is proved unconditionally: the q-Weyl relation, closure of the solution space under linear combinations, and disjointness of the saddle regimes. The conjectural inputs carry the AJ conjecture's content and the Faddeev/Rogers identifications.

The conjectural inputs are statements from the literature. The framework's contribution is the identification at the algebraic level.

Archimedean specialisation. The \Phi_q / A_J regulator identities are stated over real q with the archimedean ordering 0 < q < 1. This real-analytic regime is the archimedean side of the substrate wall.

Modularity across |q| = 1. Garoufalidis and Wheeler call a linear q-difference equation modular when, for every \gamma \in \mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{Z}), the cocycle \Omega_\gamma built from its fundamental solutions at 0 and \infty extends meromorphically from \tau \in \mathbb{C}\setminus\mathbb{R} to a cut plane, so that its restrictions to \mathrm{Im}\,\tau > 0 and \mathrm{Im}\,\tau < 0 determine each other [garoufalidis-wheeler-modular, §1, Def. 1.1 and comment 1]. Here q = e^{2\pi i\tau}, so the real line in \tau is the circle |q| = 1 on which the root-of-unity regime of \Phi_q sits, while the regime 0 < q < 1 lies inside the disc. Checking the monodromy relation at the generators S and T suffices for all of \mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{Z}) [garoufalidis-wheeler-modular, Thm. 1.2(a)]. The source proves modularity for the generalised q-hypergeometric equation, whose two natural cocycles coincide [garoufalidis-wheeler-modular, Thm. 1.4], and for three modules of complex Chern--Simons theory whose cocycles are the Faddeev quantum dilogarithm, the Appell--Lerch sums and the Andersen--Kashaev state integral of 4_1 [garoufalidis-wheeler-modular, §1.5, Thms. 1.5--1.7]. For the operator \hat A_K of the AJ statement above, modularity is the source's conjecture, not its theorem (comment~5 after Def.~1.1), so it adds no unconditional input to the proposition.
